title: Train with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body of the train -->
  <rect x='15' y='40' width='60' height='35' rx='8' fill='#e84545'/>
  <!-- Highlight on body -->
  <rect x='18' y='43' width='54' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff7b7b'/>
  <!-- Cab / chimney area -->
  <rect x='60' y='22' width='18' height='25' rx='5' fill='#c73030'/>
  <!-- Chimney top -->
  <rect x='65' y='15' width='8' height='12' rx='2' fill='#ff7b7b'/>
  <!-- Smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='10' r='5' fill='#c9d9e8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='6' r='4' fill='#e0ebf5'/>
  <!-- Face window -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='40' height='22' rx='6' fill='#2b3a67'/>
  <!-- Smiling face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='56' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='56' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='57' r='2' fill='#2b3a67'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='2' fill='#2b3a67'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M33 64 Q42 72 51 64' stroke='#ffd93d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='63' r='3' fill='#ff9e9e'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='63' r='3' fill='#ff9e9e'/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='78' r='8' fill='#3d5a80'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='78' r='4' fill='#a8c4e0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='8' fill='#3d5a80'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='4' fill='#a8c4e0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='6' fill='#3d5a80'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='3' fill='#a8c4e0'/>
  <!-- Cowcatcher front -->
  <path d='M15 75 L8 82 L15 82 Z' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='60' r='4' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='60' r='2' fill='#fff5b8'/>
  <!-- Track -->
  <rect x='5' y='86' width='90' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8b7355'/>
  <rect x='10' y='89' width='80' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a89070'/>
</svg>
